text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy has offered to help<n>me find the hero
I witnessed, and a<n>few days after that, we meet up
in the<n>school library to plan our search.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So you see, I've been making<n>progress on our hero
search on my<n>own. Um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
First, the time frame you would have<n>seen her... It
appears to match solo<n>training hours.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A lot of students come and go at that<n>time, making it
rather difficult to pick<n>out individuals from the track
usage<n>records.
choice_data_list: So that's why she's so hard to find...
So that's why she's so hard to find...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sorry... But let's get back on<n>course! How
about we search a<n>variety of training areas?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Since she was using the school track,<n>she must be
a student here... And if<n>she's as heroic as you say,
I'm sure<n>she'll stand out at a glance!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even with my limited knowledge, I'm<n>familiar with
several students one<n>might call heroes! Like, for
example...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There's a runner who behaves in<n>very peculiar
ways but is actually<n>incredibly intelligent...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Or an Umamusume who puts her<n>entire heart and
soul into closing in on<n>the lead, even when it seems
out of<n>reach.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And then there's... Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She's a student whom I greatly<n>admire. She's
powerful, fast, cool...<n>And she's even already
debuted.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Today, she's going to be running,<n>so... would you
like to go see her with<n>me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As expected, the academy track after<n>class is full of
students doing solo<n>training.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, Kris S should be... Ah! Over<n>there! And
she's already begun<n>running!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's gifted with a powerful<n>physique that makes
for impressive<n>running... but it's not the same as
the<n>heroic figure I saw that day.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The hero I remember seemed to have<n>more of a
desperate tenacity, an<n>obsessive desire to win no
matter the<n>cost.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I turn to Rob Roy to tell her this, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The way she pushes forward... It's<n>not brute force
as it may first appear.<n>I believe she has each step
perfectly<n>calculated.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She spends this much time cooling<n>down... And a bit
longer than average<n>to ice herself? Incredible...
She's so<n>exact with how she manages her<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy watches intently as<n>she takes
notes. Her ears and tail<n>twitch at the sound of the
whistle.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's almost as though she's itching<n>to...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh, not really... This is my day<n>off from
training, after all!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But we'll have to continue our search<n>another day...
It appears that Kris S<n>isn't the hero you were
looking for.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So, um... I'll be on my way then!<n>Goodbee!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That was a quick exit... I decide I<n>should probably
head back too. But<n>just as I make to leave, I notice
a<n>familiar notebook lying on the bench.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She must've forgotten it in her hurry<n>to leave. I'll
just take a peek to make<n>sure it's definitely hers...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Flipping through the book, I find<n>meticulously written
notes on Kris S's<n>training today. The writing fills
several<n>pages from top to bottom.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! Sorry to intrude, but<n>are you by any
chance Rob Roy's...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Stunned by what I'm reading, I can't<n>tear my eyes
away. All this<n>enthusiasm and passion... How does
she hide it under that quiet exterior?

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text: Um... Hellooo! Hi there!

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's just, I saw that you<n>were with Rob
Roy, right? You<n>wouldn't happen to be her trainer,
would you?
choice_data_list: No, we're working together on something, is all...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, we haven't even<n>touched on
the notion of making a<n>contract. We were totally
caught up in<n>finding my hero.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, okay... Sorry for asking out of the<n>blue. It's only
that I'm in charge of a<n>lot of her training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
You see, she's missed out on tryouts<n>a few times
due to an injury. That's<n>why she's been in a bad
way for a<n>while now.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid she might be worried about<n>debuting too
late, since it's still some<n>time before the next
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
And... I'm also worried that people<n>might be
underestimating her potential<n>as a result.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Meet's coming up, so I<n>spoke with her
about using it as a<n>chance to make more of an
impression on the trainers...

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
But she hasn't been training as much<n>lately, and
I've been worried that she<n>might've lost her
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text:
So when I saw you, I sort of got my<n>hopes up that
she found herself a<n>permanent trainer. That was
my<n>mistake though.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The instructor's apology makes me<n>feel a little
guilty. It must be because<n>of my hero search that
Rob Roy's<n>been training less. Still...
choice_data_list: I think she'll be all right.

text_block_list.name: Kindly Instructor
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she must have had a good<n>reason to
devote her precious time to<n>helping me search for a
hero.
choice_data_list: I don't think she would give up on racing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I saw it myself in her notebook.<n>Among all the
detailed analysis was a<n>note in big, bold letters that
read, "I<n>have to improve."
